Door rows never fire (no door typology yet). Notes with ASSUMPTION/CONFLICT/CHECK are open in doc/hilux-questions.md.

hardware_rules.note: Frame and every sash outer sides

hardware_rules.name: gasket for 2mm glass
hardware_rules.note: ASSUMPTION: glazing gasket by glass thickness, 1 mm gasket step per 1 mm glass (over 6 to 8 mm glass); thicker glass (DGU, laminates over 8 mm) gets no gasket and a no_glazing_gasket warning. Hilux 'x 2 sides/1side' read as 1 side, like EvA W01

hardware_rules.name: gasket for 3mm glass
hardware_rules.note: ASSUMPTION: glazing gasket by glass thickness, 1 mm gasket step per 1 mm glass (5-6 mm glass, as Task 1 / EvA W01 6 mm); thicker glass (DGU, laminates over 8 mm) gets no gasket and a no_glazing_gasket warning. Hilux 'x 2 sides/1side' read as 1 side, like EvA W01

hardware_rules.name: gasket for 4mm glass
hardware_rules.note: ASSUMPTION: glazing gasket by glass thickness, 1 mm gasket step per 1 mm glass (4 to under 5 mm glass); thicker glass (DGU, laminates over 8 mm) gets no gasket and a no_glazing_gasket warning. Hilux 'x 2 sides/1side' read as 1 side, like EvA W01

hardware_rules.name: gasket for 5mm glass
hardware_rules.note: ASSUMPTION: glazing gasket by glass thickness, 1 mm gasket step per 1 mm glass (3 to under 4 mm glass); thicker glass (DGU, laminates over 8 mm) gets no gasket and a no_glazing_gasket warning. Hilux 'x 2 sides/1side' read as 1 side, like EvA W01

hardware_rules.name: Fly mesh fixing Gasket
hardware_rules.note: ASSUMPTION: mesh shutter perimeter = sash perimeter, 1 side, only on sashes with the fly mesh option

hardware_rules.name: frame Glass Gasket for casement
hardware_rules.note: ASSUMPTION: every side of every fixed (frame-glazed) pane, same length as the glazing gasket

hardware_rules.name: Frame Packer 5 mm
hardware_rules.note: 0.5 per fastener, rounded up per frame side (reproduces EvA W01 6 and W02 4)

hardware_rules.name: Frame Packer 3 mm
hardware_rules.note: 0.5 per fastener, rounded up per frame side (reproduces EvA W01 6 and W02 4)

hardware_rules.note: 1 per fastener

hardware_rules.name: Frame Packer 1 mm

hardware_rules.note: ASSUMPTION: 8 per pane, fixed panes included (Hilux: 2 or 3 mm packer, 8 to 10 per shutter; EvA W01 8 per pane)

hardware_rules.name: Glass Packer 3 mm
hardware_rules.note: ASSUMPTION: not used by default; Hilux gives no rule for choosing 3 mm over 2 mm packers

hardware_rules.name: SS guid rail 13mm
hardware_rules.note: ASSUMPTION: sliding track rail ('per track x bottom'); casement windows have no track, so never used here

hardware_rules.name: 8x80 wall fixing fastener screw
hardware_rules.note: ASSUMPTION: EvA formula ceil(len/500) per frame side kept (reproduces EvA W01 2/3/2/3); Hilux: every 600 to 800 mm

hardware_rules.name: Hole cape
hardware_rules.note: 1 per fastener. ASSUMPTION: also on fixed windows (Hilux: not required; rules cannot yet tell a fixed window from the frame side, and EvA W02 charges them)

hardware_rules.name: WATER DRAINAGE CAP
hardware_rules.note: Sheet counts 3 fixed / 4 open at 1200 wide: 1 per 600 mm of frame bottom + 1, max 6. CONFLICT: EvA W01 (915 wide, open) has 2

hardware_rules.name: WATER DRAINAGE CAP
hardware_rules.note: Sheet counts: open windows get 1 more drain cap than fixed (added once, on the first sash)

hardware_rules.name: Sealant
hardware_rules.note: 1 bottle per window up to 6 m frame length (sheet counts 1 at 1200x1200). Unit CAN = existing Item H914. CONFLICT: EvA W01 has 1.423 (2 x perimeter / 6)

hardware_rules.name: masking tape
hardware_rules.note: ASSUMPTION: 'frame running meter 2 sides x 2' read as 2 x frame perimeter (EvA W01 8.54 m)
